purpose: Select an Arabic TrOCR checkpoint (no official one exists). Screened on the first 10 golden samples; a candidate needed to be within reach of EasyOCR (0.2332 dev/golden corpus CER) to justify a full run.

screened.failure_mode: unrelated text (handwriting-trained, no transfer to printed)

decision: NEGATIVE RESULT: no community TrOCR checkpoint is competitive on printed APTI. TrOCR engine remains implemented (models/trocr.py) but is not part of the evaluated configuration. In-domain fine-tuning is the only viable TrOCR path and was out of scope.

also_rejected_without_screening.reason: dialectal target, out of MSA scope
